title: Kaspa mining economics model: hashrate + difficulty + KAS price → revenue per TH
description: Kaspa mining economics model: hashrate + difficulty + KAS price → revenue per TH/s/day. Calculates kas-per-day yield, USD revenue, cost per TH/s (based on 40W typical ASIC + configurable electricity cost), profit margin, and breakeven KAS price. Block reward 132 KAS assumed (Kaspa emission schedule). Node-backed hashrate. Informational research data — not investment advice.
